editorial_thesis: The next practical edge is making agent work inspectable: budget memory, preserve design intent, and measure delegated execution through evidence rather than activity.

topic_groups.title: Agent Platforms + Proof-Bearing Workflows
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signals from GitHub, OpenAI, and Google point to longer-running delegated work and stronger evaluation surfaces; this advances yesterday's runtime discussion without repeating its sources.

sources.title: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack
sources.why_selected: Current platform-level signal for coding agents moving beyond autocomplete.
sources.usefulness: Use checked-in job contracts, outcome metrics, and rollback in Buildn/client delivery.

sources.title: How agents are transforming work
sources.why_selected: Frames agents as extending delegated task horizon and complexity.
sources.usefulness: Redesign automation metrics around verified outcomes and review cost.

sources.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
sources.why_selected: Tests multimodal agents on ambiguous, visual, real-world inputs.
sources.usefulness: Build messy-input evaluation fixtures from actual client artifacts.

sources.title: Inside Kaggle's AI Agents Intensive Course with Google
sources.why_selected: Shows practical agent engineering education at unusual scale.
sources.usefulness: Convert learning exercises into reusable, testable workflow templates.

topic_groups.title: Memory Under Constraints
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Memory is a coverage gap after several days of identity, runtime, and physical-agent reporting; fresh research gives a practical resource-and-evaluation angle rather than repeating memory roundups.

sources.title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
sources.why_selected: Treats memory selection as value allocation under limited resources.
sources.usefulness: Add retention reasons, freshness, and deletion rules to durable Buildn state.

sources.title: Memory in the LLM Era: Modular Architectures and Strategies in a Unified Framework
sources.why_selected: Provides a vocabulary for modular memory roles and strategies.
sources.usefulness: Separate evidence, derived knowledge, working context, and retrieval policy.

sources.title: Modular Memory is the Key to Continual Learning Agents
sources.why_selected: Connects fast adaptation with reusable accumulated knowledge.
sources.usefulness: Promote repeated successful traces into reviewed playbooks with rollback.

sources.title: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
sources.why_selected: Frames memory management as a monitor-control loop.
sources.usefulness: Log retrieval misses, stale hits, duplicates, and downstream outcomes.

topic_groups.title: Design-to-Code Surfaces
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Figma updates create a practical client-work lane around context packets, repository-aware design, shader/code handoff, and versioned generative assets.

sources.title: Figma product news and release notes
sources.why_selected: Lists agent-generated vector improvements and connected GitHub repository changes.
sources.usefulness: Audit repository permissions and test a real-component design workflow.

sources.title: Figma Config India updates
sources.why_selected: Introduces Specs, Payload, code sources, guidelines, and MCP updates.
sources.usefulness: Model a portable context packet for Buildn and client handoffs.

sources.title: Build by Design
sources.why_selected: Provides product context for Figma's design-to-code direction.
sources.usefulness: Use as a reference when defining intent, implementation, and review boundaries.
